The bugs we’ve been putting off is starting to catch up to us now that we have 50 levels of solid play.

Gameplay issues:

- Level ends prematurely where as a boss spawns right as the win screen appears.
- Sometimes a boss would double spawn, throwing off level balance.
- Hard to reproduce, but sometimes a level will start and immediately end with zero monsters spawned (victory), and zero items spawned. This seems to happen depending on how the LAST level ended. This happens in editor and also live build.
- DoT effects applied incorrectly, burn for example deals 1st tick damage on contact unlike poison where the first tick damage happens at 1st second _after_ impact. Shock is unknown how it’s dealing damage.
- The damage numbers are off sometimes, it’s almost taking an aggregate amount from various sources but applying it as a single number during kill cam.
- Enrage doesn’t apply to newly spawned monsters, unless enrage happens after the monster has spawned. (Behavior should be pre-enraged)
- Refill health and Push monster back should reset ALL enrage status. ## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

ComboTimeout2x4.5s3x4.25s......18x~0s

We need a **short, snappy 2D animation** for the Weekly Contest reward screen. The animation should bring the purple reward chest to life in a way that feels satisfying and rewarding, but **fast-paced and skippable**. 

The animation leads into the **reward icon reveal** (handled separately in development). So, we need to account for that when deciding the timing of the box opening animation. 

Guidelines:

* You can decide the animation direction. Both opening up and sliding to the side are acceptable. But I think a small wobble followed by a generic opening upward is the most satisfying. 
* Animation should be **no longer than 0.5-1 second,** since we need to spare time for the icon reveal, as well. The whole scene should take more than 2 seconds. 
* Motion should be **clean and sharp**— let's avoid floaty easing or long anticipation.
* This part of the animation should support being **interruptible** without breaking the icon reveal and claim flow, **just in case** we decide to add a skipping /freezing later.

boundary="000000000000e95d770616f0f269""}, {"name": "Bcc", "value": "victor.barnes@harmonygames.co"}], "body": {"size": 1404, "data": "Dear [PERSON_NAME_0083] and [PERSON_NAME_0116],

As we approach the conclusion of our existing contracts with Leapblock
Ltd., we would like to formally notify you of the termination of both
contracts, namely "Game of Dominoes - Forest Zone Creation" initiated on
April 7, 2023, and "Game of Dominoes - Animations" which started on
September 25, 2023. Both contracts are set to end on May 31, 2024.

We are very pleased to acknowledge that Leapblock Ltd. has satisfactorily
delivered all the required assets for these projects. Your team’s
commitment and the quality of work have significantly contributed to the
success of "Game of Dominoes" We genuinely appreciate your efforts and
professionalism throughout the duration of these contracts.

Looking forward, while these specific agreements are concluding, we will
continue our collaboration on an on-demand basis with specific individuals
from your team, per our discussion. We are also confident that There will
be numerous opportunities for future projects where [ORG_NAME_1552]’s expertise
will be highly beneficial.

Please do not hesitate to reach out to discuss any final matters related to
these contracts. We value our relationship with Leapblock Ltd. and look
forward to ongoing success together.

Thank you once again for your outstanding service and partnership.

Warm regards,
Leonard Hayes
CEO of Harmony Games"}}}

Two clarifying facts locked in: (1) Leapblock is an external art/animation vendor (Dominoes contracts closed May 2024, now on‑demand); (2) Martin Walsh is the UI/2D artist (Linear ART assignee `usr_51f5f16d46e8cf55`, `@Martin.Walsh`). input.title: Combo-Fighters VFX/Art Import — Status Brief (for Leonard, Mon Mar 2)
input.bodyText:
COMBO-FIGHTERS VFX / ART-IMPORT RECONCILIATION
Prepared by: Victor Barnes (Engineering) · Date: Feb 28, 2026
Scope: Combo-Fighters PR history since Dec 2025 (merged + unmerged), cross-checked vs. the Zombie Match 3D (ZM) roadmap board. Reconstructed from GitHub code/branch state, Trello, and Linear — not from PR titles or verbal status.

=====================================================================
BOTTOM LINE — is Leonard's "treat the import draft as parked" correct?
=====================================================================
PARTIALLY. Park the paperwork, but do NOT assume the VFX is in the shipping build.

• The draft import PR (#1, Marcus/ImportingArtAssets -> main) is SAFE to park/close. It literally contains no code: 0 additions / 0 deletions / 0 changed files, labeled "do not merge," draft. Its diff against main is empty — there is nothing hiding in it to lose. The base art already reached main via earlier develop->main merges.

• BUT "already covered by the merged VFX branch" is only half true. The real VFX DID merge — but onto develop and playable, NOT onto main:
   - main…develop = DIVERGED, 280 commits ahead / 4 behind. The combo-highlight VFX (PR #33, Combo_Vfx_Highlight.prefab + edge-glow shaders + 3rd-party VFX lib) is on develop, not main.
   - main…playable = DIVERGED, 267 commits ahead / 4 behind. The "vfx updates" bloom post-processing (PR #36) is on playable only.
   - Last develop->main promotion was Jan 17 (PRs #29/#30). Everything after — the combo-highlight VFX (#33, Jan 26), the bloom volume (#36, Feb 11), combo definitions (#37) — has NOT been promoted to main.

=> Recommendation for Monday: agree the DRAFT (#1) is parked/closable, but push back on any read that "it's done/in the build." A develop->main promotion (and a decision on the stranded playable bloom) is still owed and un-owned. This is the same failure mode as the placeholder-asset incident: "merged" was taken to mean "in the build," and it isn't.

=====================================================================
COMBO-FIGHTERS PRs SINCE DECEMBER — REAL STATE (not title)
=====================================================================
REAL VFX/ART IMPORTS THAT ACTUALLY MERGED (code landed, but on develop/playable):
• #33 "Tiles Combo Highlight" — Marcus Bennett -> develop, merged Jan 26. Genuine VFX import (Combo_Vfx_Highlight.prefab, UI glow + fire/electric beam shaders, third-party VFX library). Follow-up fixes by Oliver Brooks (outline glow, raycast target, material). ON develop, NOT on main.
• #36 "vfx updates" (bloom post-processing volume) — Marcus Bennett -> playable, merged Feb 11. Genuine, but merged to the non-default 'playable' branch; automated review was skipped (non-default base) and there was no human review. ON playable only.
• #16 "Marcus/win screen coin vfx" — Marcus Bennett -> develop, Dec 21. Real.
• #7 "electric beam and electric generator" — Marcus Bennett -> Marcus/ImportingArtAssets, Dec 11 (sandbox scene). Real VFX; reached main via later merges.
• #22 "New Ground Shadow" / #9 "Enemy Shadow" / #27 "girl hero color texture" — Marcus Bennett, smaller shader/art, merged.
• #19 "anim sequence on combo changed" — gameplay engineer (GitHub PERSON_5877), combo visual sequence, -> develop Dec 30.
• #3 "player complete animations and animator and combos" — Marcus Bennett, merged.
• #11 "marketing capture + fixed fireball material" — Marcus Bennett -> integration branch, merged.

PLACEHOLDER / INTEGRATION-BRANCH ITEMS (NOT standalone VFX imports):
• #1 "Marcus/importing art assets" — DRAFT, OPEN, label "do not merge", 0/0/0 files. THE draft to park. No code in it — flag for close-out.
• #2, #4, #25 — develop->Marcus/ImportingArtAssets integration merges (plumbing).
• #10, #32 — develop->Marcus/ImportingArtAssets reconcile PRs, CLOSED UNMERGED (integration branch was abandoned mid-reconcile).
• #20 — superseded duplicate of #21 (debug level loader), closed unmerged.

MERGED-BUT-CONTESTED (counts as "still open" per your rule): NONE FOUND. No human review pushback exists on the VFX PRs — reviews are empty; automated review was skipped on the draft (#1) and on #36 (non-default base). So nothing is "merged with unresolved review debt." The real gap is promotion-to-main, not review debt.

ONLY OPEN PR: #1 (the empty draft). Everything else is closed.

=====================================================================
OWNER ATTRIBUTION — WHICH MARCUS
=====================================================================
The GitHub author on all the recent Combo-Fighters art/VFX work shows only as "Marcus" with NO company email on the GitHub profile. That account is Marcus BENNETT (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co) — our 3D/VFX artist. Confirmed by cross-referencing Linear: the artist who owns the identical "Marcus/…" working branches (e.g. ART-760 "my working branch is Marcus/SagaMap_UnlockButtons_VFX") is the Linear user marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co, whose account maps to the Marcus Bennett contact record.
   -> All "Marcus/*" Combo-Fighters branches (#1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 13, 16, 22, 27, 33, 36) = Marcus Bennett.
   -> Do NOT confuse with the two other Marcuses: marcus@harmonygames.co (bare "Marcus", non-user contact) and Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@harmonygames.co). Neither authored this code.
   -> The "Marcus" who reportedly told Leonard the import is covered is the same Marcus Bennett (the author of the VFX). Worth confirming with him directly which branch/build he means.

Other owners:
• Oliver Brooks (oliver.brooks@harmonygames.co) — lead engineer; merged nearly all art PRs, owns develop and the develop->main promotion, authored the VFX integration fixes. He is the owner of the missing promotion-to-main.
• Arthur Blake (arthur.blake@harmonygames.co, "Blake") — backend/analytics/IAP (#14, #17, #24, #34, #35). Not VFX.
• Calvin Price (calvin.price@harmonygames.co) — VFX-implementation engineer on the ZM side (Linear master ticket ZOM-521, ART-760).

=====================================================================
ZM ROADMAP CROSS-CHECK (ZM ROADMAP board) — ITEM BY ITEM
=====================================================================
IMPORTANT CAVEAT: The ZM roadmap VFX cards are Zombie Match 3D work — a DIFFERENT game/repo from Combo-Fighters, mostly from 2025. They are not produced by, and are not evidence for, the Combo-Fighters import. What they DO confirm is the studio pattern you flagged: cards flipped to "done" while checklist items sit open.

• Card #15 "[Improvement] Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation - Oleg" (list "Jun 30th"):
   - Card marked dueComplete = TRUE (Jun 30, 2025).
   - "Workflow" checklist: "Marcus to create VFX" = INCOMPLETE; "Engineer to implement" = INCOMPLETE. History shows both were briefly toggled complete then reverted on Jun 20 and never re-checked — yet the card was closed as done.
   - Underlying Linear: ZOM-247 "Add VFX for card infusion at start of level" = DONE (Jun 26, 2025), assignee Marcus Bennett -> the VFX asset was created. Its engineering child ZOM-248 "Oleg to implement equipped card infusion VFX" = CANCELED as DUPLICATE -> the engineering implementation was never tracked to a confirmed landing.
   - Reconciled action taken: checked "Marcus to create VFX" (asset creation done per ZOM-247); left "Engineer to implement" OPEN (no confirmed landed implementation); comment added flagging owner attention.

• Card #31 "Card upgrade VFX implementation" (list "Jun 18th"): no checklist, no description, marked done. Nothing tracked item-level; can't verify — marked done with zero workflow evidence.

• Card #22 "Reward Animations (VFX) - Kutay/Marcus/Edgardo" (list "BETA: Oct 10"): no checklist; marked done; description is a bundle of Slack-reported asks (infinite-lives anim for Plague Race, Endless Horde rewards-screen VFX, zombie idle-animation bug). No item-level tracking to reconcile.

=====================================================================
STILL OPEN / NEEDS OWNER ATTENTION
=====================================================================
1. Promotion of develop -> main (combo-highlight VFX #33 + follow-up glow/material fixes). Owner: Oliver Brooks. This is the real "not done."
2. Stranded bloom VFX on 'playable' (#36) — decide whether it's meant for main; it also never got a human review. Owner: Marcus Bennett + Oliver Brooks.
3. Close out draft PR #1 (empty, "do not merge") once #1/#2 above are confirmed. Owner: Marcus Bennett / Oliver Brooks.
4. ZM Card #15 "Engineer to implement" (equipped card infusion) — confirm whether the engineering implementation actually landed and in which build. Owner: Calvin Price / Oleg.
5. Stale bookkeeping across ZM VFX cards (#15, #31, #22 marked done with open/absent checklists) — hygiene pass. Owner: roadmap owner.

Linear reconciliation logged on ZOM-247 (see comment). Trello Card #15 updated (comment + checklist reconciled). Vendor follow-ups (Leapblock, Martin Walsh) tracked in the companion sheet.

Done. Here's the straight answer plus what I changed.

## Does the reconciliation support Leonard's "treat it as parked"?
**Partially — park the paperwork, but push back Monday on any read that "it's covered / it's in the build."**

- **The draft (PR #1, `Marcus/ImportingArtAssets` → main) is genuinely safe to park/close.** It has **zero code**: 0 additions / 0 deletions / 0 changed files, draft, labeled "do not merge." Its diff against `main` is empty — nothing is stuck in it. That part of Leonard/Marcus's read holds.
- **But "already covered by the merged VFX branch" is only half true.** The real VFX *did* merge — onto `develop` and `playable`, **not `main`**:
  - `main…develop` = **diverged, 280 ahead / 4 behind** → the combo‑highlight VFX (PR #33: `Combo_Vfx_Highlight.prefab`, glow/beam shaders, 3rd‑party VFX lib) is on develop, not main.
  - `main…playable` = **diverged, 267 ahead / 4 behind** → the "vfx updates" bloom volume (PR #36) lives only on `playable`, and it merged to a non‑default branch with **no human review** and automated review skipped.
  - Last `develop→main` promotion was Jan 17 (#29/#30). Everything after — #33 (Jan 26), #36 (Feb 11), #37 — is **not on main**.

So: agree the draft is parked, but the develop→main promotion (and the stranded `playable` bloom) is still owed and un‑owned. That's exactly your old failure mode — "merged" being taken to mean "in the build." Don't sign off on that framing without Oliver Brooks confirming the promotion.

**Review‑debt check:** no merged VFX PR has unresolved review pushback (reviews are empty across the board), so nothing counts as "still open" on that basis. The only open PR is the empty draft #1.

## Which Marcus
The GitHub art author shows only as "Marcus" with **no company email on the profile** — that account is **Marcus Bennett** (`marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co`), our 3D/VFX artist. Confirmed by matching his identical `Marcus/*` working branches in Linear (e.g., ART‑760). **Not** the bare `marcus@harmonygames.co` contact, and **not** Marcus Lee. All `Marcus/*` CF branches (#1, 3, 5–7, 9, 11–13, 16, 22, 27, 33, 36) = Marcus Bennett. The "Marcus" who told Leonard it's covered is the same person — worth asking him which branch/build he means.

## ZM roadmap cross‑check (item by item)
Note these cards are **Zombie Match 3D** (different game/repo from Combo‑Fighters, 2025 work), so they don't validate the CF import — but they confirm the pattern you flagged:
- **Card #15 "Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation – Oleg"**: marked done (Jun 30, 2025) with **both** checklist items open. Reconciled against Linear: "Marcus to create VFX" → **done** (ZOM‑247 Done, Marcus Bennett); "Engineer to implement" → **still open** (impl child ZOM‑248 was closed as Duplicate — never confirmed landed).
- **Card #31 "Card upgrade VFX"** and **Card #22 "Reward Animations (VFX)"**: marked done, no checklists/description — nothing tracked to verify.

## What I changed
- **Trello Card #15**: checked ✅ "Marcus to create VFX"; **left "Engineer to implement" open**; posted a reconciliation comment flagging Calvin Price / Oleg to confirm the implementation actually shipped.
- **Linear**: reconciliation comment on **ZOM‑247** (the closest tracking ticket — there's no dedicated ART‑team ticket; card‑infusion VFX lives under the ZOM team).
- **Drive doc**: "Combo‑Fighters VFX/Art Import — Status Brief (for Leonard, Mon Mar 2)" — send‑ready.
- **Sheet**: "Vendor Follow‑ups — Leapblock & Martin Walsh" — Leapblock (on‑demand art vendor; Dominoes contracts closed May 2024) and Martin Walsh (UI/2D artist, distinct from Marcus Bennett) items, ready for you to confirm/extend.

One heads‑up: I logged the Linear note on **ZOM‑247** rather than an ART‑team ticket because none exists for this — if you meant a specific ART ticket, point me at it and I'll move the note.
